stance: Housing is weak at a low level. September starts fell 5.2% to 1,221k SAAR after -5.9%, a second straight decline. Permits held near 1,400k (-0.2%), which is the leading signal and suggests starts stabilise rather than fall further. Existing sales of 3.99M (+1.5%) edged past consensus but are lagging closings, and mortgage rates near 7.4% cap affordability. Residential investment is a GDP drag. A permits print below 1,350k or weak new home sales would confirm further deterioration. View is provisional.
